Do I need to create an account or have an internet connection to use Deal Hub?
No. The app runs entirely in your browser, and your data stays in memory for the session only, and you can export and import it as a local file whenever you want.
How do I move a deal between Kanban board stages?
Drag the deal card and drop it into the desired column, and the move is logged automatically in the unified log with the new stage name.
What's the difference between the unified log and custom views?
The unified log gathers activities, comments, notes, and tasks for all deals, while custom views let you filter and sort deals and choose which columns appear.
Is my data saved after I close the page?
It isn't saved automatically; click «Export JSON file» before closing, then use «Import file» to restore it in a later session.
